rules: Classify the source evidence function, not the original broad representation tag.
Graphs, geometric/spatial diagrams, photographs, actual data/state tables, response frames, Pascal arrays and procedure flow charts are graphics.
Formula boxes, prose/NOTE/REMEMBER panels, rule lists and worked-algebra callouts are text callouts. Formula-reference panels do not become graphics merely through a border or aligned cells.
Mixed panels containing an actual graph/number line/table retain graphic status.
No new content verification or learner reuse permission follows from this taxonomy.
